The '''Assassination of Moff Tarrick''' was a covert [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] operation perpetrated by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Pierce]]'s [[Pierce's black ops team|black ops team]], which resulted in the death of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tarrick (Moff)|Tarrick]].
